description: §61.2 — a comment inside an `<endpoint>` opener (`/* note */`) is a run the markup attribute reader drops: E-ATTR-001 at the comment. The opener is refused rather than read without it.
provenance: S480 #2007 review (S239) item 1; §61.2 as amended by #1998 review r2 N1
rationale: §61.2: "A character that reader drops (a `'`, a backtick, a `{…}` / `${…}` block or a comment with no attribute name, a value it cannot read) or a stray `=` / value is `E-ATTR-001` at that character, never skipped".
